verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser provides official SDKs (e.g. @hyperbrowser/sdk installable via npm, confirmed by runtime probe) with documented methods like page.ai() and page.extract(), plus an official MCP server, giving AI-native developers first-party building blocks. missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec or docs.md found (probes 404), and no independent third-party review specifically praising SDK developer experience.
